evidence.supports: The SSL pipeline builds weak labels and successive segmentation models across A2C, A4C, and SAX views.
A2C examples show weak labels, predictions, and human segmentation visual aids for LV and LA anatomy.
A4C examples include LV, LA, RV, RA segmentation semantics and difficult clinical cases.
SAX examples show circle-derived weak labels and recovered LV segmentation through the pipeline.
Clinical and SSL-derived chamber measurements are compared with r2 and Bland-Altman summaries.
Noisy ultrasound boundaries, frame selection, missing labels, and further validation remain important limits.
